note: The Critical workflow_run path was judged real: `pr-check.yml` runs for every completed pull_request run of `tests.yml`, forks included, checks out `workflow_run.head_sha` and runs `pip install .` with a `statuses: write` token, so a fork marks its own commit green on a required check. A doubt on fork reachability stays open: the job's first step reads `.pull_requests[0].number` from the triggering run and exits when it is empty or null, which is typical of runs whose head is a fork (GitHub leaves `pull_requests` empty for them), so a fork may never reach the checkout; the label keeps the verdict, which judged the path real.

paths.pending: `github.event.workflow_run.event` is not modelled for an outsider (a fork pull request makes it `pull_request`), so the gate of the workflow_run job reads unknown and the real Critical drops to an unverified High.
